test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held On: 30 June, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Identify the idiom that best expresses the meaning of the underlined group of words.

There are a number of things that the country needs to improve but the __main part of the problem__ is corruption.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Crux of the matter**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"main part of the problem"** in the given sentence refers to the most essential or most important aspect of the problem faced by the country, i.e., corruption.
 
• **Crux of the matter:** the most important point or central aspect of a matter. (मामले का मूल बिंदु).
 
 
• **Example:** In solving the crime, the crux of the matter was the missing weapon.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is- ***Crux of the matter***.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Last resort **(अंतिम उपाय) refers to a final option used when all others have failed.
 
• **Grasping at straws **(तिनका पकड़ना) means to be so desperate that you try even the most unlikely means to find a solution. 
 
• **Dodged a bullet** (बाल-बाल बचना) means to narrowly avoid a disaster or dangerous situation.
